requirements.desc: When `src/flow/lib/auto-check-static.js` is loaded, G_KEYWORDS must contain only the 9 specified keywords, exclude the 14 removed keywords, and keep H_KEYWORDS/I_INVERSIONS unchanged.
requirements.note: G_KEYWORDS now matches the exact 9-item set; removed terms are absent; H_KEYWORDS and I_INVERSIONS were not changed.

requirements.desc: When `fetchIssue(number, root, { strict: true })` is called, it must run `gh issue view <number> --json title,body,labels,state` synchronously, return `{ title, body, labels, state }` on success, and throw on failure; with `strict: false`, return null and emit one stderr warning line on failure.
requirements.note: `src/flow/lib/fetch-issue.js` implements strict/lenient behavior with sync `runCmd`, returns the required shape, throws in strict mode, and warns+null in lenient mode.

requirements.desc: When `src/flow/lib/get-issue.js` executes with ctx.number, it must call `fetchIssue(number, root, { strict: true })` and return `{ number, title, body, labels, state }` without changing externally observable envelope/error behavior.
requirements.note: `get-issue.js` now delegates to `fetchIssue(..., { strict: true })` and keeps returned fields and command structure intact.

requirements.desc: When `src/docs/lib/lang/md.js` `minify(text)` is called, it must apply the specified transformations in order (a)-(e), keep `<details>...</details>` unchanged, and export `truncate(text, maxChars = 20000)`.
requirements.note: Handler and `truncate` were added, but transform order is not exact (trailing-whitespace removal runs before blank-line collapse), and `<details>` is not explicitly protected from internal transformations.

requirements.desc: When `src/docs/lib/lang-factory.js` is loaded, EXT_MAP must include `.md` mapped to md handler, with other mappings unchanged.
requirements.note: `.md` mapping was added and no other extension mapping changes appear in diff.

requirements.desc: When `src/docs/lib/minify.js` runs and handler exports `preserveBlankLines === true`, it must skip generic `removeBlankLines` and apply only `removeTrailingWhitespace` then `handler.minify`; otherwise keep prior behavior. md handler must export `preserveBlankLines === true`.
requirements.note: Pipeline now branches on `preserveBlankLines`; md handler exports `preserveBlankLines = true`.

requirements.desc: When `flow set init --issue <n>` runs and gh fetch succeeds, it should store minified+truncated issue body in preparing state `issueBody`; on fetch failure it should continue without `issueBody` and print one warning line.
requirements.note: `set-init.js` uses shared normalization helper; failures in lenient fetch return null with warning and do not fail init.

requirements.desc: When `flow prepare` runs and preparing state has `issueBody`, it should write `issue.md` in spec directory; if absent, do not create `issue.md`.
requirements.note: `run-prepare-spec.js` writes `issue.md` from `preparingState.issueBody`; no write occurs when `issueBody` is absent.

requirements.desc: When `flow set issue <n>` runs in active mode and gh fetch succeeds, it should write minified+truncated body to `specs/<spec>/issue.md`; on failure, leave issue.md unchanged, set state.issue, and warn.
requirements.note: `set-issue.js` sets issue state and only writes `issue.md` when normalized body exists; lenient fetch emits warning on failure.

requirements.desc: When `buildBaseInput(state, paths)` in `resolve-auto-check-input.js` is called, it should use request+state.issueBody in preparing mode, request+`issue.md` in active mode, fallback to request+`Issue #<n>`, and warn on issue.md read I/O errors.
requirements.note: Implementation adds issueBody/issue.md precedence and fallback behavior, with required warning format on read errors.

requirements.desc: When this spec is implemented, required tests (a)-(e) must be added and all pass under `npm test`.
requirements.note: All listed test files were added/updated, but diff alone cannot prove `npm test` PASS; also R10 warning-output assertion is not clearly covered in `resolve-auto-check-input` unit additions.

summary.notes: Core functional requirements R1-R3 and R5-R10 are implemented. Main gaps are strict compliance nuances in R4 (exact transform order and guaranteed `<details>` non-modification) and verification completeness for R11 (test pass evidence and explicit warning assertion coverage).
